verses.text: Hallelu YAH! Praise YHWH from the heavens; praise Him in the heights!

segments.text: Hallelu YAH! Praise YHWH from the heavens; praise Him in the heights!

verses.text: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts!

segments.text: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts!

verses.text: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all stars of light!

segments.text: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all stars of light!

verses.text: Praise Him, O heavens of heavens, and waters that [are] above the heavens!

segments.text: Praise Him, O heavens of heavens, and waters that [are] above the heavens!

verses.text: Let them praise the name of YHWH, for He commanded, and they were created.

segments.text: Let them praise the name of YHWH, for He commanded, and they were created.

verses.text: And He established them for ever to forever; He made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

segments.text: And He established them for ever to forever; He made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

verses.text: Praise YHWH from the earth, sea creatures and all the depths;

segments.text: Praise YHWH from the earth, sea creatures and all the depths;

verses.text: fire and hail, snow and clouds, wind of storm—doing His word;

segments.text: fire and hail, snow and clouds, wind of storm—doing His word;

verses.text: mountains and all hills, trees of fruit and all cedars;

segments.text: mountains and all hills, trees of fruit and all cedars;

verses.text: the beast and all cattle, the crawling thing and bird of wing;

segments.text: the beast and all cattle, the crawling thing and bird of wing;

verses.text: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth;

segments.text: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth;

verses.text: young men and also maidens, old with young:

segments.text: young men and also maidens, old with young:

verses.text: Let them praise the name of YHWH, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor above the earth and the heavens!

segments.text: Let them praise the name of YHWH, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor above the earth and the heavens!

verses.text: For He has raised up the horn of His people, the praise from all His saints, from the sons of Israel, a people near to Him. Praise YAH!
